title: Ehasan
tagline: Flutter app on Codeberg for a charitable / community product client.
overview: Ehasan is a Flutter product client published on Codeberg in late 2025. Named for ihsan / charitable work; the public tree is the Dart app itself.
problem: A community/charity-shaped mobile client needed a public repository that was not mixed into GitHub client work.
solution: Publish the Flutter app on Codeberg and list it as its own case study.
architecture: Flutter/Dart application. Details live in the Codeberg tree.
challenges: Sparse README — the repo is the source of truth
lessonsLearned: Name and forge location are part of how a product is found
futureImprovements: Add a short Arabic/English README in-repo
